messages:
June: Pushed a mock of the new mini-map (bottom-right) that shows viewport and lets users scrub timeline. Thoughts? :thought_balloon:
Marco: Nice. Two quick concerns: 1) when viewport small the grab handle overlaps legend. 2) scrub focus ring is super faint.
Li: Agree on focus. For keyboard users we need a clear 2px contrast ring and arrow-key scrubbing with 1s steps.
Anika: UX nit: the mini-map currently auto-zooms when you scrub near edges which fights users trying to trim a selection. Can we make edge-snap optional?
June: edge-snap was to keep crosshair onscreen. Maybe only enable snap when holding Shift?
Marco: alternative: show a soft shadow indicating auto-scroll zone, don't jump unless user crosses a hard threshold (90%).
Li: Accessibility: mini-map should have role="slider" aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow representing center timestamp. Also announce 'Viewport from 12:01 to 12:05' on change.
Anika: Good. Also add aria-describedby linking to microcopy explaining scrub behavior: 'Use left/right to nudge; Shift to lock panning'.
June: microcopy proposal for legend tooltip: "Viewport: shows visible range. Drag to pan, Shift+drag to lock." Thoughts?
Marco: wording ok but shorten: "Drag to pan. Shift+drag to lock" (for small tooltip space).
Li: keyboard shortcut doc: Left/Right = 1s, Shift+Left/Right = 10s, Home/End jump to start/end. Add to help overlay.
Anika: When series are heavily zoomed in, Y-axis label precision increases (we show 4 decimals). Ops team complains it's noisy. Suggest dynamic rounding: determine significant digits based on range magnitude. Example: if max-min < 0.01 then show 4 decimals else <= 1 show 2 decimals.
June: nice rule. Add config: axisPrecision: "auto" | number. Default auto.
Marco: Outlier handling question: when a single spike is >100x median, rendering the scale makes everything flat. We already discussed clipping but maybe we should also add an 'adaptive focus' toggle that temporarily scales to highlighted series on hover.
Li: adaptive focus feels useful for investigation but dangerous for dashboards shared across team. Make it opt-in per-user and not persisted in saved dashboards unless user explicitly toggles 'save view'.
Anika: A11y for adaptive focus: announce when adaptive focus activates: 'Adaptive focus enabled for series X; axis rescaled'. And provide an easy way to disable via keyboard (press A).
June: Telemetry question: TelemetryBot, can we log how often users hit the mini-map vs using scroll?
TelemetryBot: metric recorded: chart.mini_map.interaction.count (daily) + chart.mini_map.method = {drag, click, keyboard}. Also can tag event with 'edge_snap_used: true/false'.
Marco: Implementation detail: mini-map overlay should be pointer-events: auto and not capture wheel events meant for main chart. Use capture gating in JS to forward wheel if not interacting with mini-map.
Li: For clipped points marker let's use a small up-chevron (▲) with aria-label 'clipped value'. Also include tooltip 'Value clipped at display max'.
Anika: CSV export: include columns 'displayed_value' and 'raw_value' like previous thread. Make sure timestamps are ISO-8601.
June: I'll update the prototype: fix legend overlap by moving mini-map 8px left when legend present, strengthen focus ring, add aria attrs and short microcopy edits.
Anika: I'll add keyboard spec and microcopy to the a11y checklist.
Marco: I'll prototype adaptive-focus toggle as a feature flag so we can test.
Li: Great. Let's review updated prototype Thursday.
